title: __mesh_bpf_metrics plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `__mesh_bpf_metrics` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component MeshBpfMetricsConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

MeshBpfMetricsConfig.description:
Plugin: __mesh_bpf_metrics - reserved internal mesh NodeWaypoint
plugin that exposes BPF SOCK_OPS counters and fixed-bucket TCP
latency histograms (SRTT / SYN-to-ACK / accept-to-first-byte)
on the Prometheus scrape surface. Mesh mode auto-injects a
global instance on NodeWaypoint; operator-managed plugin configs
should not create names prefixed with `__`. Enabled instances
must use `scope: global` (at most one enabled instance per
process). Registration is OptionalFailOpen: Admin create/update
still returns HTTP 400 for an invalid enabled config, while
file-mode load/`ferrum-edge validate` and plugin-cache rebuild
warn and omit the instance.

Object configs are closed: the only admitted key is `prefix`.
A string `prefix` is trimmed before the identifier check.
Non-object configs (null, string, array, number, boolean) keep
the default prefix `ferrum_mesh_bpf`.

prefix.description:
Prometheus metric name prefix for every emitted BPF family
(`{prefix}_tcp_events_total`, `{prefix}_drops_total`,
`{prefix}_srtt_microseconds`, `{prefix}_syn_to_ack_microseconds`,
`{prefix}_accept_to_first_byte_microseconds`, and the ringbuf
families). Surrounding whitespace is trimmed before the
identifier check; the trimmed value must match
`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` and must not be empty. There is no
declared length limit beyond that grammar. Omit the key to
keep `ferrum_mesh_bpf`.
